dnsRequirements.evidence: For the recommended GitHub Pages architecture, apex record categories are A and optionally AAAA; www and preview use CNAME when configured as platform custom domains. Exact targets must come from the current GitHub Pages repository/account setup and platform documentation; the repository contains no supported account-specific values. MX is out of scope.
